edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by Target.setValue and later persisted as the recorded sender without any authorization check.
Target.setValue writes the untrusted msg.sender into the public sender state variable.
Target.setValue writes the _v argument into the value state variable.
Parameter _v flows into the body of Target.setValue.
Constructor parameter _target is written into Proxy.target.
Proxy constructor initializes the target state variable.
Parameter _v flows into Proxy.setValue.
Proxy.setValue triggers the external call operation on the target contract.
Parameter _v is forwarded as the argument of the external target call.
Proxy.target supplies the receiver address of the external call.
Constructor parameter _proxy is written into Caller.proxy.
Caller constructor initializes the proxy state variable.
Parameter _v flows into Caller.setValue1.
Caller.proxy provides the destination address of the low-level call.
Parameter _v is ABI-encoded into the low-level call payload.
Caller.setValue1 executes a low-level external call to an externally supplied address, allowing the callee to re-enter the Caller contract before the success check completes.
The success flag returned by the low-level call is captured in the local variable.
Caller.setValue1 declares and assigns the success local variable.
Parameter _v flows into Caller.setValue2.
Caller.proxy provides the destination address of the delegatecall.
Parameter _v is ABI-encoded into the delegatecall payload.
Caller.setValue2 delegatecalls into the proxy address, so externally supplied code executes with the Caller storage and can overwrite sender/value without authorization.
The success flag returned by the delegatecall is captured in the local variable.
Caller.setValue2 declares and assigns the success local variable.
Factory constructor deploys a Target and stores its address in target.
Factory constructor deploys a Proxy and stores its address in proxy.
Factory.createCaller reads the stored proxy address when constructing a new Caller.
createCaller stores the freshly deployed Caller address in the local caller variable.
createCaller pushes the new Caller address into the callers array.
The local caller variable is returned by Factory.createCaller.
The external call performed inside Proxy.setValue invokes Target.setValue on the target contract.
The low-level call in Caller.setValue1 invokes Proxy.setValue on the proxy contract, re-entering an external callee.
The delegatecall in Caller.setValue2 executes Proxy.setValue logic inside the Caller storage context, redirecting state writes to Caller.sender and Caller.value.

normalization_plan.reason: The _v parameter has no independent semantic meaning outside the function body and should be folded into Target.setValue.
The _target constructor parameter is only used to initialize Proxy.target and can be merged into the constructor node.
The _v parameter is only forwarded to the external call inside Proxy.setValue and adds no separate semantic node.
The _proxy constructor parameter is only stored in Caller.proxy and should be merged into the constructor.
The _v parameter is only ABI-encoded into the low-level call made by Caller.setValue1.
The _v parameter is only ABI-encoded into the delegatecall made by Caller.setValue2.
The success local variable is a temporary result of the low-level call and belongs to Caller.setValue1.
The success local variable is a temporary result of the delegatecall and belongs to Caller.setValue2.
The caller local variable is a temporary handle for the new Caller and can be merged into Factory.createCaller.
